6014.title: Untracked directory attaches interrupted by recovery
6014.rootCauseOneLine: Directory-move attaches bypass the environment operation registry, so recovery fails their pending environments before successful attach settlement.
6014.proposedFix: Track directory attaches in the existing environment-operation registry and await completion without swallowing command failures.
6014.caveats: Deterministic server-route reproduction on Linux; original macOS timing and physical reconnect not measured.
